Фабрика ещё не открыта: зайди в /cf и на: The factory isn't unlocked yet: open /cf and click 50 Chocolate on Rabbit Bro.
Престиж обнуляет Chocolate и сотрудников: Prestige resets Chocolate and employees, but raises the multiplier, employee cap and Chocolate ceiling. Found rabbits and the Rabbit Barn stay.
Кап сейчас {0}. Цена считается по формул: Cap now {0}. The price uses the wiki formula (without the Zeta −1% discount). A new employee appears when the previous one reaches level 20.
Цены — по вики. Сверху то, что ускоряет: Prices from the wiki. On top are the ones that speed up the factory the most.
+0,1× к множителю за уровень, пока башня: +0.1× multiplier per level while the tower runs. 3 charges of 8 h, each an hour of boost. Rabbit Mu adds +0.7×, Einstein gives a charge every 7 h.
+2% к шансу редкого кролика в Hoppity's: +2% rare rabbit chance in Hoppity's Hunt per level (up to +40%).
Сколько разных кроликов вмещает коллекци: How many different rabbits the collection holds. Above the limit, new rabbits get "crushed". Doesn't reset.
+1 Chocolate per click, up to 10 per click.
Ловит пропущенные яйца, пока тебя нет. С: Catches missed eggs while you're away. A slot cools down for 20 minutes after giving an egg.
Событие идёт каждый игровой год с Early: The event runs every in-game year from Early Spring 1 for almost three in-game months. Every real hour 9 eggs appear: Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner three times each.
Яйца появляются на всех островах в одних: Eggs appear on all islands in the same spots. 6 eggs live at once, a new one replaces the oldest. You can take only one egg per spawn; the same egg on another island won't give a rabbit.
Яйцо даёт случайного кролика. Повтор пре: An egg gives a random rabbit. A duplicate turns into Chocolate: from 150 seconds of production for Common to 15,000 for Divine, +10% per duplicate (up to +100%).
Удобнее всего искать в Crystal Hollows:: The easiest place to search is the Crystal Hollows: all spots are near the Crystal Nucleus. Without HOTM 4, the Gold Mine. The Egglocator from the Chocolate Shop shows the nearest egg.
Hoppity в Hub продаёт до 7 кроликов за м: Hoppity in the Hub sells up to 7 rabbits for coins: Common 250k, Uncommon 500k, Rare 1M, Epic 2.5M, Legendary 5M.
Бродячий кролик сидит в окне фабрики 20: A stray rabbit sits in the factory window for 20 seconds: click it. After an egg it appears within 30 seconds, with a 10% chance (20% with Omega) of being golden.
+5 Chocolate/с до конца игрового года, с: +5 Chocolate/s until the end of the in-game year, stacks
немного Chocolate, на третий раз — Legen: a little Chocolate, on the third time the Legendary rabbit El Dorado
Резиденты стоят на своём острове круглый: Residents stay on their island all year round. Go there and click the rabbit. SkyHanni highlights the exact spots.
Места яиц, где ты ещё не брал яйцо: Egg spots where you haven't taken an egg yet
За первое яйцо в каждом месте острова ид: The first egg at each spot on an island counts toward the spot collection.
У тебя {0}. Каждая веха — уникальный кро: You have {0}. Each milestone is a unique rabbit.
Вехи Chocolate Shop (потрачено в магазин: Chocolate Shop milestones (spent in the shop)
Потрачено {0}. Zeta (250 млн) даёт −1% к: Spent {0}. Zeta (250M) gives −1% employee price, Mu (25B) +0.7× to the Time Tower, Omega (800B) golden rabbits twice as often.
Магазин открывается из окна фабрики. Лим: The shop opens from the factory window. The purchase limit resets every in-game year. Everything spent here counts toward shop milestones.
Каждый новый кролик навсегда добавляет C: Every new rabbit permanently adds Chocolate per second and multiplier. Mythic gives a special bonus, Divine +1 employee cap.
Chocolate Factory открывается командой /: The Chocolate Factory opens with /cf. Chocolate builds up by itself: employee rabbits make it, and found Hoppity rabbits raise the speed and multiplier.
Chocolate тратится на сотрудников, улучш: Chocolate is spent on employees, upgrades and the Chocolate Shop. All-time Chocolate unlocks milestone rabbits, shop spending unlocks its own milestones.
Когда накопишь нужное количество с прошл: Once you've saved the required amount since the last prestige, you can raise the factory level (prestige, up to 6). It's the main multiplier growth.
Всего кроликов {0}. Их дают яйца Hoppity: Total rabbits {0}. They come from Hoppity's Hunt eggs in spring, stray rabbits in the factory window, milestones and island residents.
